title: Hold a motor vehicle repair business licence
what: Hold a motor vehicle repair business licence before carrying on a business that does repair work.

sources.title: Motor Vehicle Repairers Act 2003 (WA)
sources.quote: A person or firm must not carry on a business that consists of or includes the carrying out of repair work except under and in accordance with a business licence.
